topic: The cricket match played during a war that made both sides stop fighting
hook: A cricket match stopped a war. Even for one day.
script: A cricket match stopped a war. Even for one day. During World War One, British and German soldiers played an impromptu game in No Man's Land during the Christmas truce. Rifles down. Bats up. Two hours of sport between men who were supposed to kill each other. Then the war resumed. Follow for stories where sport revealed our shared humanity.
